Unit tests for race sanitizer async, weave, and injection behavior.

# Purpose
This file is a unit test for the `fd_racesan` race-sanitizer support code. It checks three related parts of the API: direct hook injection with `fd_racesan_inject`, asynchronous execution with `fd_racesan_async`, and interleaving control with `fd_racesan_weave`. The test code uses small counter functions such as [`cas_inc`](<#cas_inc>) and [`async_cas_dbl`](<#async_cas_dbl>) that call `fd_racesan_hook` at a known point, then verifies that injected actions and scheduled steps change the shared state as expected.

The file also defines the program entry point. When `FD_HAS_RACESAN` is set, [`main`](<#main>) boots the runtime, runs the three tests, prints `pass`, and stops the process. When `FD_HAS_RACESAN` is not set, [`main`](<#main>) prints a skip message and exits. This makes the file a self-contained executable test that depends on the race-sanitizer build option and validates the public `fd_racesan` interfaces.
